entities.name: Imoti
entities.description: Naga druid of Amonkhet who purifies her tribe's river with the blessing of the god of nature.

events.summary: Imoti refused to become leader of her tribe, dedicating her life to protecting the river.
events.quote: The tribe tried to elevate her to the leader, but she refused

events.summary: Imoti fought in defense of Amonkhet during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Imoti fought in defense of Amonkhet during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
